text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen has arrived. 
Gold City brushes off the compliments on 
her appearance with a look of resignation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the paddock, Tamamo Cross cheerfully 
called out, saying this was the showdown 
she'd been waiting for. However, seeing 
Gold City devoid of spirit made her 
visibly irritated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Gold City heads for the race, 
believing that there is still a chance to 
change how she is perceived—
